about: Six of the seven moments whose new picture the owner judged not right in the first fal check (30 Sep), drawn again with the fixes made for them, each judged blind against the picture he failed. lighthouse-fresh m10 is left out: its root is the breakdown seeing it from outside, which the frozen dream keeps.
name: fal-redo
base: the first fal check's pictures of the same moments
